$comment: Read by scripts/audit-claims.mjs over dist/**/*.html, dist/**/*.xml, JSON-LD and alt text. Classes follow SAGE-PLAN 3.2 (C-06 to C-17, C-24). The package names Spark, Launch, Accelerate and Studio are allowed (owner decision 2026-10-09, C-10); the seat price literal is added by the operator when flags change, and numbers are never recorded here. Investor Introductions is allowed as a flat-fee add-on (C-14), and the rules block only success-based, commission and guarantee wording. Four sections: `rules` (unconditional; the source-level unit tests in tests/unit also apply these to the repository, so add a rule here only when no source file matches it), `contextRules` (wording that is legitimate in a few named places; applied to the built output only), `required` (text that must be present on the listed `routes`, on every page whose <main> text matches `whenMatches`, or only when `when` holds; `whenFlags` sets the regex flags of `whenMatches`, default "i") and `manifestRules` (checks on src/assets/photo/manifest.json). A context rule can carry `disabledByFlag` (inactive while that flag in src/data/flags.ts is on), `allowPaths` (route regexes where it does not apply), `markerAllowed` (elements marked data-claim-allow="<rule id>" or "*" are skipped) and `genericDefinitionAllowed` (elements marked data-generic-definition are skipped).

rules.description: A currency amount tied to a seat or monthly rate
An investor network. WE offers curated, limited introductions as a paid add-on; it does not claim a network of investors
A promise of meetings, introductions or investor contact. A negation such as "cannot promise a meeting" or "no guarantee of meetings" passes
A years-of-experience claim (FLAG-YEARS; the registry shows the entity filed in 2022)
Specific security controls asserted as practice
Agreement title is not for public pages

contextRules.description: Public benefit corporation wording while FLAG-PBC (pbcWording) is off

Success-based, contingent, commission, carried-interest or equity pay for investor introductions. Investor Introductions is a flat fee that does not depend on any investment closing. The audit scans built output only; add data-claim-allow="C-14-success-based" to an element that must quote the wording in order to deny it
"Fundable" stated as an outcome WE delivers (WE promises no funding). "Fundability" and a question such as "will this make my company fundable?" do not match
Implied peer group, staff or alumni while none exist. Allowed on the FAQ, which answers "is WE an accelerator?", and on the metrics definitions page, where "cohort" is an analytics term
The phrase is permitted on the dedicated-teams page only
UK spelling; the site uses US spelling (a Delaware company)
The company is "WE" in capitals, not the pronoun "We", in sentences about what it does

required.text: WE makes no promise of funding.
required.description: The no-funding disclaimer must be visible on the pages that talk about investors and fundability

required.text: Introductions are a flat-fee service. WE is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser, takes no fee or stake tied to any investment, and cannot promise a meeting or funding.
required.description: The Investor Introductions disclaimer (src/components/blocks/introductions.ts) must be visible on the pages that describe the add-on

required.text: Introductions are a flat-fee service. WE is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser, takes no fee or stake tied to any investment, and cannot promise a meeting or funding.
required.description: Any page whose main content names the add-on, on a route not listed above, must carry the same disclaimer. The trigger is read from <main> only, so a nav or footer mention never triggers it

required.text: The fee does not depend on whether any investment closes.
required.description: The structure the owner set on 2026-10-09: the fee is flat and is not contingent on any investment closing

required.text: Illustrative images, some AI-generated. Figures shown are not real people, founders, clients or WE staff.
required.description: Once any photo manifest slot has source "generated", every page footer must carry the disclosure line (src/lib/photo-disclosure.ts)

manifestRules.description: Alt text of a generated image describes the activity, never an identity, role or relationship, and is never empty
